curation_note.zh: 精选自个人科研收藏，优先保留官方数据库、公开数据集、成熟分析工具与科研绘图资源。链接指向公开入口；数据可用性、访问权限和版本以各站点为准。
curation_note.en: Curated from personal research bookmarks, prioritizing official databases, public datasets, established analysis tools, and scientific-figure resources. Links point to public entry points; data availability, access, and versions are determined by each provider.

description.zh: 脑区结构、细胞定位、空间图谱与神经连接资源。
description.en: Reference atlases for brain anatomy, cell localization, spatial organization, and neural connectivity.

description.zh: Allen Institute 的脑科学资源门户，整合脑区解剖、基因表达、细胞类型与连接组资源。
description.en: An Allen Institute portal integrating brain anatomy, gene expression, cell types, and connectivity resources.

description.zh: Seattle Alzheimer's Disease 项目的人脑细胞图谱与病理资源入口。
description.en: A human brain cell atlas and pathology resource from the Seattle Alzheimer's Disease project.

description.zh: PsychENCODE 相关的人脑多组学与调控资源浏览入口。
description.en: A browser for PsychENCODE-related human-brain multi-omics and regulatory resources.

description.zh: 面向脑组织空间转录组数据的交互式图谱浏览入口。
description.en: An interactive atlas for exploring spatial transcriptomics in brain tissue.

description.zh: 猕猴脑空间细胞图谱与脑区信息浏览资源。
description.en: Spatial cellular atlas and neuroanatomical resources for the macaque brain.

description.zh: 脑空间转录组与多模态图谱浏览平台。
description.en: A platform for exploring brain spatial transcriptomics and multimodal atlases.

description.zh: BRAIN Initiative 神经科学多组学数据的交互式分析入口。
description.en: An interactive analysis portal for BRAIN Initiative neuroscience multi-omics data.

description.zh: 脑细胞类型与基因表达的交互式浏览器。
description.en: An interactive browser for brain cell types and gene expression.

description.zh: 覆盖人脑发育与成年阶段的时空转录组资源。
description.en: Spatiotemporal transcriptomic resources spanning human brain development and adulthood.

description.zh: Allen 小鼠连接组项目的三维脑区与神经连接浏览器。
description.en: A 3D browser for brain regions and neural connectivity from the Allen Mouse Connectivity project.

description.zh: 单细胞、单核、空间转录组及细胞类型注释与浏览平台。
description.en: Portals and tools for single-cell, single-nucleus, and spatial transcriptomics, including cell-type annotation.

description.zh: Broad Institute 的单细胞研究数据集、表达分析与可视化门户。
description.en: A Broad Institute portal for single-cell studies, datasets, expression analysis, and visualization.

description.zh: 基于参考图谱的单细胞数据映射与细胞类型注释工具。
description.en: Reference-based mapping and cell-type annotation for single-cell datasets.

description.zh: 国家基因库时空组学数据库，汇集空间组学数据与浏览工具。
description.en: A CNGB resource for spatial omics datasets and exploration tools.

description.zh: 浏览单细胞转录组数据集与细胞群表达模式。
description.en: Browse single-cell transcriptomic datasets and cell-population expression patterns.

description.zh: 单细胞 DNA 甲基化数据资源与浏览入口。
description.en: A database and browser for single-cell DNA methylation data.

description.zh: Olah 等人 2020 年人类小胶质细胞单细胞表达数据浏览器。
description.en: A browser for human microglia single-cell expression data (Olah et al., 2020).

description.zh: 人类脊髓单核 RNA 测序数据的交互式浏览器。

description.zh: 代谢、信号转导与疾病相关通路数据库。
